description: Permanently delete an event or entire recurring series; individual expanded occurrences are not supported. Target it by resource_id or by calendar_id with uid, and supply expected_etag when available to prevent deleting a concurrently changed event.

calendar_id.description: Opaque calendar ID returned by list_calendars. Provide it together with uid when resource_id is unavailable.

expected_etag.description: ETag previously returned for the event. When supplied, deletion fails if the event changed since it was read.

resource_id.description: Opaque event resource ID returned by list_events or get_event. Provide it alone instead of calendar_id and uid.

uid.description: iCalendar UID of the event. Provide it together with calendar_id when resource_id is unavailable.

name: delete_event

deleted.description: Confirms that the resource was deleted.

resource_id.description: Opaque ID of the deleted event resource.

title: Delete calendar event
